name: mspm0g3507
description: TI MSPM0G3507 (Cortex-M0+, 80 MHz, 128 KB flash, 32 KB SRAM, CAN-FD, MATHACL, AES, TRNG): GNU Arm toolchain with the MSPM0 SDK (headers, startup, linker script, DriverLib), Renode MSPM0 models

image.notes: load the ELF ({kind: elf}) to get the symbols, or the LoadBinary images of build_firmware. Sources use the SDK headers (#include <ti/devices/msp/msp.h>, DriverLib <ti/driverlib/driverlib.h>).

renode.notes: Pins: 'iomux PinLevel <n>' (PA n = n, PB n = 32 + n), 'iomux RecordPin <n>' then 'iomux PinEdges/PinFrequency/PinDuty <n>'; external pin level: 'iomux OnGPIO <n> true'. ADC inputs: 'adc0 SetChannelVoltage <ch> <V>'. Without a debugger __BKPT escalates to HardFault (exception 3), as on the device. Peripheral notes: tools/mspm0/PERIPHERALS.md. Board with LEDs/buttons: platforms/boards/ti/lp_mspm0g3507.repl.

reference.simulator: none; peripheral models checked with the MSPM0 SDK DriverLib examples (tools/mspm0/run_examples.py and the examples_*.txt specs in the Renode tree)
